arguments.code:
playlist_ids=[195,194,193,192,196]
results=[]
for pid in playlist_ids:
    pl=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid,access_token=token)
    songs=pl.get('songs',[])
    durations=[s.get('duration') for s in songs]
    total_seconds=sum(durations)
    total_minutes=total_seconds/60
    results.append({
        'playlist_id':pid,
        'title':pl.get('title'),
        'num_songs':len(songs),
        'total_seconds':total_seconds,
        'total_minutes':total_minutes,
        'rounded_minutes':round(total_minutes)
    })
print(results)
# find shortest by total_minutes
shortest=min(results, key=lambda x:x['total_minutes'])
print('shortest',shortest)
